import os, math

# Ensure we have tokens and song_meta from prior steps
pw = {d['account_name']: d['password'] for d in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
spotify_access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ka_burt@gmail.com', password=pw['spotify'])['access_token']
fs_access_token = apis.file_system.login(username='ka_burt@gmail.com', password=pw['file_system'])['access_token']

# Prepare CSV

def csv_escape(val: str) -> str:
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',','\n','\r','"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

# song_meta: song_id -> (title, artists_str)
items = list(song_meta.items())
print('song_meta_items', len(items))

# Deduplicate already by song_id; create stable deterministic order by title then artists then id
items_sorted = sorted(items, key=lambda x: (x[1][0].lower(), x[1][1].lower(), x[0]))

lines = ['Title,Artists']
for sid,(title,artists_str) in items_sorted:
    lines.append(csv_escape(title) + ',' + csv_escape(artists_str))
content = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
print('csv_lines_total', len(lines))
print('csv_content_preview_first3')
print('\n'.join(lines[:4]))
print('csv_content_preview_last3')
print('\n'.join(lines[-3:]))

# Create directory and write file
backup_dir = '~/backups'
file_path = '~/backups/spotify.csv'

# Ensure dir exists
resp_dir = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_access_token, recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True)
print('create_directory_resp', resp_dir)

# Write/overwrite file
resp_file = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_access_token, content=content, overwrite=True)
print('create_file_resp', resp_file)

# Verify exists and show size-ish by reading first/last
exists_resp = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_access_token)
print('file_exists_resp', exists_resp)

show_resp = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_access_token)
print('show_file_keys', list(show_resp.keys()))
print('show_file_path', show_resp.get('path'))
print('show_file_content_preview')
print(show_resp.get('content','')[:200])
